The material does not give any share-of-revenue percentages, and I cannot compute them, so I cannot confirm which categories exceed 20% of FY2022 revenue. The reported FY2022 figures are below.

By product and service category, Boeing reported sales of products of $55,893 million [1] and sales of services of 10,715 million [2], against total revenues of 66,608 million [3].

By segment, Commercial Airplanes had revenues of $25,867 million [4], Defense, Space & Security had 23,162 million [5], and Global Services had 17,611 million [6].

The percentage of total revenue for each category is not in the material.
